title: Power Meter
text: Measure power and the CCDF of the power of voltage signal in Simulink, 2 inputs, 5 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Measurement} sets Desired; {Reference load (ohms)}, {Output power units}, {Compute CCDF}, {Window length}, {Overlap length}, {Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals}, {Power range (dB)}, {Power resolution (dB)}, {CCDF output}, {Specify probability (%) for relative power output} sets the probability for relative power output, {Specify relative power (dB) for probability output} sets the relative power for probability output 3; 6; 9; {Reset port} enables reset port and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: PAPR
ports.summary: Peak-to-average power ratio scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Prob
ports.summary: Probability in percentage N -by- M matrix

params.name: Measurement
params.values: Desired power measurement Average power (default) | Peak power | Peak-to-average power ratio | All

params.name: Reference load (ohms)
params.values: Reference load in ohms 1 (default) | positive scalar in ohms

params.name: Output power units
params.values: Units of measured power values dBm (default) | dBW | Watts

params.name: Overlap length
params.values: Overlap length between windows 255 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals off (default) | on

params.name: Power range (dB)
params.values: Power range in dB 50 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Power resolution (dB)
params.values: Power Resolution in dB 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: CCDF output
params.values: CCDF output Relative power (dB above average power) (default) | Probability (%) | Relative power and probability (whole CCDF curve)

params.name: Specify probability (%) for relative power output
params.values: Specify probability for relative power output [ 10; 1; 0.1; 0.01; 0.001; 0.0001 ] (default) | column vector

params.name: Specify relative power (dB) for probability output
params.values: Specify relative power for probability output [ 0; 3; 6; 9; 12 ] (default) | column vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
